definitions.explanation: A specific instance or example of something that has occurred, often used as a reference or precedent. Common in academic, legal, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{事例|じれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧{事例|じれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧にして⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てた→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: I made a plan by referring to successful cases.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧ような{事例|じれい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧おり、⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急|いそ}がれている→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧。
examples.english: Similar cases have been reported nationwide, and countermeasures are urgently needed.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧{事例|じれい} (success story, successful case)
- {事例|じれい}⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧ (case study)
- ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{事例|じれい} (past cases)
- {事例|じれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}する→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧ (to introduce examples)
- ⟦{具体的|ぐたいてき}→具体的：04781_gutaiteki⟧な{事例|じれい} (concrete example)

REGISTER: {事例|じれい} is a formal word used in written and professional contexts. In casual conversation, ⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧ or ⟦{例|たと}え→例え：04128_tatoe⟧ is more natural for "example."
